channel.title: Sifted
channel.description: Recorded fixture feed. All companies are fictional.

item.title: Pellwharf raises £1.8m seed for port call optimisation
item.description: Canary Wharf maritime software startup Pellwharf has raised a £1.8m seed round to cut the time cargo ships spend waiting outside ports.

item.title: Tansy Money raises £600k pre-seed for gig worker savings
item.description: Soho fintech Tansy Money has raised £600k pre-seed to build automatic savings buffers for gig economy workers with irregular income.

item.title: Foxglove Diagnostics raises £2m seed round for at-home blood testing
item.description: King's Cross biotech Foxglove Diagnostics has raised a £2m seed round for its at-home capillary blood testing kits, with results read in its London lab.

item.title: Granite Bay Bio raises $12m Series A to expand its New England lab network
item.description: Boston-based Granite Bay Bio has raised a $12m Series A to add three sites to its New England contract research lab network.

item.title: Oldcastle Compute raises £1.5m seed for GPU scheduling
item.description: London developer tools startup Oldcastle Compute has raised a £1.5m seed round for its GPU workload scheduler for ML teams.

item.title: Wrenfold raises £1.2m seed for its stealth fintech
item.description: London fintech Wrenfold has raised £1.2m in seed funding, according to a new Companies House filing. The company is still in stealth and has no public website.
